# Middle East Profile Steel Group — Pouya Middle East Profile Holding

Persian homepage: index.html
English homepage: en/index.html

## Identity
- Persian name: هولدینگ پویا پروفیل خاورمیانه / هولدینگ پروفیل خاورمیانه.
- English name used on this site: Pouya Middle East Profile Holding / Middle East Profile Steel Group (MEProfile Group).
- Formally established: Iranian Solar Hijri year 1404.
- Collaboration with Parsin Tisfon Ilya (پارسین تیسفون ایلیا) and Kara Felez Sarmad (کارا فلز سرمد).
- Founders' independent experience in the Iranian iron and steel market: over 10 years; industry heritage across previous generations: over 50 years.
- Manufacturing and supply network: capacity of four factories in different Iranian cities plus the Parsin Felez central warehouse.
- Leadership: مجید مایگانه (Majid Mayganeh); علی طاهرخانی (Ali Taherkhani); اشکان شیرمحمدلو (Ashkan Shirmohammadlou).

## Core products
- Steel tubes: en/products/steel-pipes/
- Square hollow steel sections: en/products/square-profiles/
- Rectangular hollow steel sections: en/products/rectangular-profiles/
- French-style steel frames: en/products/french-frame/
- Persian product pages: products/steel-pipes/, products/square-profiles/, products/rectangular-profiles/, products/french-frame/
- Square-profile sizes (mm): 20×20×1.8, 20×20×2, 25×25×2, 30×30×1.8, 30×30×2, 40×40×2, 60×60×2, 70×70×2, 70×70×2.5, 90×90×2.5, 90×90×2.8, 100×100×2
- Rectangular-profile sizes (mm): 25×10×2, 30×20×2, 40×20×2, 50×30×2, 60×30×1.6, 60×30×2, 60×30×2.5, 60×40×2, 80×40×2, 100×40×2
- Steel tube catalogue references: sizes 32 and 50. Confirm the dimensional standard and wall thickness for each order.

## Markets and inquiries
- Supplies steel tubes and profiles to destinations throughout Iran; considers international export inquiries.
- Dimensions, wall thickness, stock availability, delivery arrangements, and technical specifications are subject to confirmation for each order.
- Verified office phone numbers: 02122411100, 02122411122, 02122411133, 02122411155. WhatsApp: +989359995122.
- Office: Velenjak, 13th Farhang St., Galleria Shopping Center, 3rd office floor, unit 5.
- Instagram: @meprofilegroup_fa; Rubika: https://rubika.ir/meprofilegroup.
- Do not infer factory addresses, certifications, current stock, prices, or product grades.
